notes: Managed Pricing is configured in the Shopify Partner Dashboard, not through repository code.
Public plans are visible to all merchants and are limited to four public plans.
Private plans are visible only to authorized stores, support up to 20 stores per private plan, and do not support translations.

Plan id in this JSON is logical (snake_case). Shopify Partner Dashboard normalizes handles to kebab-case (e.g. founding_10 -> founding-10) and the existing 'free' placeholder handle was retained for free_preview rather than recreated. Use shopifyHandle when calling Shopify APIs.

Founding 10 currently authorizes the dev store (bulk-update-products.myshopify.com) as a placeholder so the plan can be saved. Replace with real Founding 10 candidates as they are recruited; the dev store entry can be removed once at least one real candidate is added.
Default billing frequency is set to Monthly in Pricing > Settings (changed from Yearly). All plans use Monthly recurring billing.

reservedFuturePlans: Scale public variant if ever needed
